result.summary: The page is mostly well rendered, but the bottom navigation bar has one clear defect: the 'Orders' tab is missing its icon. The carousels, category chips, promo banner, and restaurant cards otherwise look correct.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar has no icon. Home, Search, and Profile all show an icon above their labels, but Orders shows only the text, leaving an empty gap. This makes the nav bar look inconsistent, suggesting the icon asset failed to load or render.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the Orders icon (e.g., a receipt or bag glyph) is correctly referenced, bundled, and rendered at the same size and color as the other inactive tab icons. Add a fallback so an icon always shows if the asset fails to load.
